Use a style definition to print orange text, for example `console.print("Hello", style="#ffa500")`. Rich also supports colors in console markup; see the [Styles documentation](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst). For help applying this in your code, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
